items.hook: American Civil War: A US Navy ship captures a Confederate raider in a Brazilian seaport.
items.body: The American Civil War was a civil war in the United States between the Union and the Confederacy, which was formed in 1861 by states that had seceded from the Union to preserve slavery in the United States. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.

items.hook: Buddhist crisis: Amid worsening relations, outspoken South Vietnamese First Lady Madame Ngo Dinh Nhu arrives in the US for a speaking tour, continuing a flurry of attacks on the Kennedy administration.
items.body: The Buddhist crisis was a period of political and religious tension in South Vietnam between May and November 1963, characterized by a series of repressive acts by the South Vietnamese government and a campaign of civil resistance, led mainly by Buddhist activists. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.

items.hook: The American Task Force on Palestine (ATFP) is an organization founded in 2003 to advocate that it is in the American national interest to promote an end to the Palestinian–Israeli conflict through the creation of a Palestinian state alongside Israel.
items.body: It has not been active since 2016. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: The 1958 Pakistani coup d'état inaugurates a prolonged period of military rule.
items.body: The 1958 Pakistani military coup was the first military coup in Pakistan that took place on 27 October 1958. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: President Kennedy signs the ratification of the Partial Nuclear Test Ban Treaty.
items.body: The Partial Test Ban Treaty (PTBT), formally known as the 1963 Treaty Banning Nuclear Weapon Tests in the Atmosphere, in Outer Space and Under Water, prohibited all test detonations of nuclear weapons except for those conducted underground. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: ALD-52, also known as 1-acetyl-LSD (1A-LSD) and falsely as "Orange Sunshine", is a psychedelic drug of the lysergamide family related to lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD).
items.body: One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Jessica Love is an American theater actress, author, and illustrator.
items.body: She is best known for her debut children's picture book Julián is a Mermaid, which has won the Stonewall Book Award and Klaus Flugge Prize. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: A hunter discovers three gray whales trapped under the ice near Alaska; the situation becomes a multinational effort to free the whales.
items.body: Operation Breakthrough was a US-Soviet effort to free three gray whales from pack ice in the Beaufort Sea near Point Barrow in the U.S. The world is stranger than it lets on.
